# reselling_kubernetes_kubeconfig (Data Source)

The admin kubeconfig of a Kubernetes cluster. It is stored in the state as a sensitive value; protect the state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_kubernetes_kubeconfig" "main" {
  cluster_id = reselling_kubernetes_cluster.main.id
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  content  = data.reselling_kubernetes_kubeconfig.main.kubeconfig
  filename = "${path.module}/kubeconfig.yaml"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) kubeconfig YAML.
